value: Direct supervision: the polysomnographic technologist providing supervision shall be present in the area where the polysomnographic procedure is being performed and immediately available to furnish assistance and direction throughout the performance of the procedure
General supervision: the polysomnographic procedure is provided under a physician's direction and control, but the physician's presence is not required during the performance of the procedure
supervision_level_definitions.quote: "direct supervision" means that the polysomnographic technologist providing supervision shall be present in the area where the polysomnographic procedure is being performed and immediately available to furnish assistance and direction throughout the performance of the procedure; ... "general supervision" means that the polysomnographic procedure is provided under a physician's direction and control, but the physician's presence is not required during the performance of the procedure

"polysomnographic trainee" means a person who is enrolled in an accredited sleep technologist educational program that is accredited by the American academy of sleep medicine

advisory_committee_composition.value: Five members who are residents of New Mexico: two (later three) credentialed by the BRPT/licensed polysomnographic technologists; one licensed physician certified in sleep medicine by a national certifying body recognized by AASM; one person at board's discretion; one public member not economically or professionally associated with health care
advisory_committee_composition.quote: The committee shall have five members, who are residents of New Mexico, appointed by the board as follows: (1) two members who are credentialed by the board of registered polysomnographic technologists; provided that when the New Mexico medical board begins issuing licenses, this category of committee members shall be three licensed polysomnographic technologists ... (2) one licensed physician who is certified in sleep medicine by a national certifying body recognized by the American academy of sleep medicine; (3) one person whose background is at the discretion of the board; and (4) one member of the public who is not economically or professionally associated with the health care field.
